content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":208,"severity":"major","message":"The regex for stripping 'www.' has incorrect TLD pattern. The character class [a-z.\\-\\d] includes a dot (.), which allows matching multi-label TLDs like 'co.uk' as a single unit. Additionally, the quantifier changed from {2,63} to {1,62}, contradicting the comment that states TLD min length is 2 and max is 63. This could cause incorrect www stripping for hostnames like 'www.example.co.uk' (would match and strip, leaving 'example.co.uk') and allows single-character TLDs which don't exist in practice."}]}
